hero.headline: A quieter drawer, and chats that stay cheap
hero.sub: Everything since 0.41.0 in one release. The left menu is calmer, and Eco mode is one setting for the whole Mac, on by default.

shot.alt: The left drawer of the orbit demo project. Under the project name: Super Agent (off), New window, and a Team row opened to five members: Churn Watch with a red 1, Analyst, Monday metrics, Nightly churn check and Release Scout, each with its own picture.
shot.caption: The project section is one calm list: Super Agent, New window, Team. A number marks the member that waits on you.

blocks.title: Eco mode keeps long chats cheap
blocks.body: A long chat costs more with every message. Eco mode, now one setting for this whole Mac and on by default, nudges a chat to move to a fresh one at 300k tokens and asks harder at 650k. A chat's own switch changes only that chat.

shot.alt: Settings, Chat page, in the orbit demo project. The Eco mode switch is on: New chats in every project suggest moving to a fresh chat as their context fills, a nudge at 300k tokens, a firmer one at 650k. Above it Model and effort and Permissions; below it Let the agent name its tab.

blocks.text: Antigravity stays in beta. docs/tool-parity.md says row by row what was seen in a real turn, on Codex and on Antigravity.
The rest of this release, such as Telegram bots for AI Team members, shared apps and the faster CLI start, is in the changelog: those screens cannot be shown here.

closer.title: Get 0.41.9
closer.body: The app updates itself. New here? Download it from the latest GitHub release, or run npm i -g dreamcontext.
